steps.what: List publisher forms waiting for an address
Complete forms that notify publishers of changes
Check the address on each publisher form
Send only the signed publisher form
outputs: filed copy of signed publisher form v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists publisher forms that are waiting for an address. The carrier completes the forms and checks the address. A later job in {EMAIL} sends only the signed form. A blank new address is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Publisher forms were posted before the address was checked.
tasks.enabler_now: Publisher name, old address, and new address are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Completing the form stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the address is right.

ambition.what: Sign the publisher form the day the stored address changes.

tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the form, not on listing publishers.

reach.task: Receive only the form the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Publisher name, old address, and new address are stored on the publisher record. The publisher record produces them. A blank new address is not sent. The send is the signed form and no other text.
Native configuration of the publisher record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier completing forms that notify publishers of changes.

incremental.description: Refresh publisher name, old address, and new address when the form layout changes, and drop a form the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many new addresses are blank. The high end assumes publisher name, old address, and new address are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
